text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The new year had begun, and I was visiting a shrine
for Hatsumode with Aston Machan.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
—Mic test, mic test.
Hello, good evening. It's Chan-Mi.
Today, Trainer-san and I are visiting the shrine for Hatsumode.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
There are so many people,
they might end up discovering
that Machan is here.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: There are lots of stalls set up. Since I'm here, I think I'll grab a bite to eat.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
That's all from Aston Machan
this New Year's. See ya~.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It seems she was recording a voice memo, which is one of her hobbies.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Thanks to her brilliant performance at the Sprinters Stakes, her view counts had skyrocketed over the past year.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: If we keep this up, I only hope we can continue to see steady upward growth this year, even if gradual.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Now then.
What should I do, what should I eat?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Wow, smells great. Excuse me,
one taiyaki please~

text_block_list.name: Store Staff A
text_block_list.text:
Yes, here you go... Oh?
Could you be... Aston Machan?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
! Ehehe, that's right.
It's Aston Machan.

text_block_list.name: Store Staff A
text_block_list.text:
My, oh my!
I saw you on TV in the Sprinters Stakes!
Your run was absolutely amazing~!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Ehehehe. I'll work even harder this year,
so I look forward to—

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: Eeeek!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looking toward the scream...
A crowd had gathered a short distance away,
surrounding a very familiar face.

text_block_list.name: Vodka Fan A
text_block_list.text:
"I went to watch the Shuka Sho and the Arima Kinen!
I could practically feel the rivalry crackling between them!"

text_block_list.name: Daska's Fan A
text_block_list.text:
I'm really looking forward to the rivalry
between you two this year as well—!

text_block_list.name: Vodka Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Um, excuse me, is it true you're always fighting at the academy!?
Even though you came to the New Year's shrine visit together!?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
"P-Please calm down a bit!
Making such a fuss will disturb everyone else...!"

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Um, I'm currently off-duty, so any information regarding my future plans will be in magazines—

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Now, now, what's the harm in a little bit?!
It just means they're cheering for ya that much!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I'll answer just one question!
After that, we're done here! Got it?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Vodka's proposal brightens the room instantly,
and hands start shooting up one after another.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Hey, you over there!

text_block_list.name: Daska's Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Is there a title in the Senior Class that you refuse
to let your rival take, no matter what?!

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text:
............
I don't want it taken from me in the Senior Class...

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: ...The Tenno Sho (Autumn).

text_block_list.name: Daska & Vodka
text_block_list.text: Hah!?

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: Eeeek!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
............
Shrill, squealing screams.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Far from the lively circle celebrating the New Year,
...Aston Machan let out a small sigh.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Monopolizing all the attention
seems like quite a tall order, doesn't it~?

text_block_list.name: Store Staff A
text_block_list.text:
"...True, those two put on quite a show last year.
Rivals clashing against each other is
inherently thrilling to watch, after all."

text_block_list.name: Store Staff A
text_block_list.text:
Still, you were right up there with them.
You showed your stuff in the Sprinters Stakes,
and you were incredible in your Classic year too, weren't you?

text_block_list.name: Store Staff A
text_block_list.text: "Don't go moping around. You've got fans of your own, you know."

text_block_list.name: Store Staff A
text_block_list.text: So... here, have an extra taiyaki on the house!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I firmly placed the bag containing two taiyaki
into the hands of a bewildered Aston Machan.

text_block_list.name: Store Staff A
text_block_list.text: Good luck, I'm cheering for you!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
...Ehehe, thank you so much.
Machan will do her very best.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I'll eat one today...
and save the other for tomorrow's snack.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: ...Mm, I mean, no. That is correct.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Here you go.
Let's eat together, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I accepted the taiyaki, savoring the happy feeling
that we had grown just a little closer...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Nom, nom...
...This is delicious.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Any tiny bit of frustration I had
got swallowed right up along with the piping hot food.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
After all,
Machan should just be Machan.
First, treasure the friends you have now—

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: I haven't given my New Year's greetings to my dear friends yet!
choice_data_list: Are you two close friends or something?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Chloe Harvard-san, who always gives me energy; the genius stray cat Shinobimaru Hattori; and Arimura-san, who harbors infinite potential!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Umm, for now...
For now...—
choice_data_list: To Chloe Harvard, who always cheers me up
To the genius stray cat, Hattori Shinobimaru.
To Arimura-san, who holds infinite possibilities.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Indeed.
First and foremost, Miss Chloe would be best!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Happy New Year.
I look forward to working with you again this year.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Is your family doing well?
Did you go visit the shrine?

text_block_list.name: Crow
text_block_list.text: Caw! Caw!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I see.
I'm glad to hear you're doing well.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: While finishing up the greetings to close friends, the sun began to set—

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
If we don't head back soon,
it'll turn into night.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Shall we...
head home now, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Side by side, the two walked home along the road bathed in the crimson light of the New Year.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Sounds great!
Let's go to the shopping arcade!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Hattori Shinobimaru~. Meow...
...He's nowhere to be found, is he?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: ...Mmh, that is...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu! There you are.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Curled up like a piece of mochi, taking a nap. Is it because it's New Year's?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: While finishing up the greetings to close friends, the sun began to set—

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
If we don't head back soon,
it'll turn into night.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Shall we...
head home now, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Side by side, the two walked home along the road bathed in the crimson light of the New Year.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
...You're right.
The odds of an encounter are low... but precisely because they are, we must start from the very beginning!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
...Hmm,
they're usually around here, though.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Hello there, little ants.
Let's see...
Mr. Ant-a, Mr. Ant-zono, and Mr. Ant-ki.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"Do you happen to know
where Arimura-san is?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: While finishing up the greetings to close friends, the sun began to set—

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
If we don't head back soon,
it'll turn into night.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Shall we...
head home now, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Side by side, the two walked home along the road bathed in the crimson light of the New Year.
